Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.
He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and…
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself…
Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

translations.web: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
